'''Andy Hopkins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[March 2000 Terre Haute tournament]] on 18 March 2000, according to Matthew Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d358">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-19-terre-haute-indiana-3-18-00d358/ terre-haute-indiana-3-18-00], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 19 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-19-terre-haute-indiana-3-18-00d358/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
